releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.10.2 - Voucher Card Layout Fix (No More Overlap)
releaseNotes:
• 📱 VOUCHER CARD OVERLAP FIX: the 'using quota' (used/limit MB) number and the 'time' (uptime / time-left) numbers no longer print over each other on the vouchers list. The time cluster is now a single bounded, ellipsized text and the quota number automatically shrinks (…) on narrow screens.
• 🎨 Time-left text now uses the readable theme-aware green.
• 🔧 v1.10.1 preserved: exact Using/Expired/Unused tab math, safe cleanup, readable usage metrics.

Install over v1.10.1/v1.10.0/v1.9.2 — same signature, no uninstall.
